comment: Reproducible source list for ir/mch_ir.json (the PRODUCTION artifact). Paths are relative to the mch package dir (indexer/indexer/events/mch/). Order == matcher registration order; equal-priority matchers tie-break on this order. specs_decl/jettons.mch (declarative jetton family) and specs_decl/pton_transfer.mch carry in-spec `priority 90` so they register ahead of the priority-100 specs regardless of position, replacing the former 'a_jettons_decl.mch' filename-sort hack. pton_transfer shares the 0x0f8a7ea5 anchor with jetton_transfer and must stay listed AFTER it: the tie-break on this order is what makes a real (internal-leg) transfer get consumed first, mirroring the legacy matchers list. Regenerate: python -m indexer.events.mch.ir_emit --manifest ton-index-worker/ton-mch-engine/ir/emit_manifest.json -o ton-index-worker/ton-mch-engine/ir/mch_ir.json (run from indexer/ with the venv python). specs_decl/dedust_v2_swap.mch is listed right after the dedust family and BEFORE the stonfi/tonco swap specs, mirroring the legacy matchers list (dedust_v2.matchers() sits between DedustSwapBlockMatcher and StonfiSwapBlockMatcher); it also anchors on btype jetton_transfer, so it must stay after the priority-90 jetton specs that build those blocks. specs/teleitem_auction.mch sits at its file-name-sort position: neither of its anchors (0x487a8e81 / 0x371638ae) is claimed by another spec, so its position carries no tie-break — it happens to mirror the legacy list, where both Teleitem matchers follow the telegram/getgems nft purchase matchers.
excluded_note: specs/jetton_transfer.mch and specs/jettons.mch are DELIBERATELY OMITTED (A4). They are builder-tier conformance references (duplicate jetton_transfer/burn/mint matchers of specs_decl/jettons.mch), permanently C++-skipped, and inert in Python (decl-jettons at priority 90 consume the blocks first). Keeping them in the production artifact only produced duplicate/ambiguous name-keyed shadow counters + dead SKIP lines. They stay in specs/ for the Python conformance suite (which references them by matcher name), so suffixing was not an option.
